args.text:
Hi Ruth, Gideon Sato asked me to email Odile Brandt (Carrowmere Cloud, our hosting vendor) the Hartford timeline from #inc-vtg-hartford so she can match it to their gateway logs. Since she's outside pemberline.com, I need your OK before I send it, even as a draft.

Proposed content (all from the incident channel, 2026-08-03, times as shown there):
• First report: 10:42 AM (gate kiosks offline at Vantorre's Hartford plant, both inbound lanes white-screening after badge scan)
• Kiosk 1 back: 11:03 AM
• Both lanes working: 11:07 AM

Address: odilebrandt@carrowmere.example (the directory address; Gideon typed a slightly different one). Do you approve?

Gideon, I haven't sent it yet. Odile is outside pemberline.com, so Ruth Calloway has to approve any mail to her first, even as a draft. I've asked Ruth in a DM and recorded the request. Nothing goes out until she says yes.

The timeline I pulled from #inc-vtg-hartford (3 Aug, times as shown in the channel):
- **First report:** 10:42 AM. Gate kiosks were offline at the Hartford plant, with both inbound lanes showing a white screen after badge scan.
- **Kiosk 1 back:** 11:03 AM.
- **Both lanes working:** 11:07 AM.

The channel doesn't state a time zone, so Odile will need to line these up against her logs herself.

The address you gave (odile.brandt@carrowmere.example) isn't the one in the directory. The directory has odilebrandt@carrowmere.example, so that's the one I put in the request to Ruth. Tell me if you know it should be the other.

Once Ruth approves, I'll prepare the mail to Odile. I can only save it as a draft in your mailbox, so you'd need to send it yourself. Since you're time-pressed, you may also want to nudge Ruth directly.
